summary: Canada Goose Holdings filed a routine Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's periodic report) for the second quarter ended September 27, 2026, containing interim financial statements, MD&A, CEO/CFO certifications and a press release. Revenue rose to C$274.0M from C$258.8M, with an operating loss of C$21.6M and a net loss of C$26.3M (C$0.27 basic/diluted), including a C$7.8M loss from discontinued operations. No transaction, stake, price or board recommendation is disclosed; watch segment margin trends and the discontinued-operations divestiture accounting rather than any arbitrage angle.
